completion_criteria.text: Detailed SPEC authored in a fresh session and user-approved, covering archive layout, per-thread v2 seeding, and plugin install/setup
v1 ledger archived - relocated so it cannot collide with the continuity-ledger store subdirs, frozen read-only, contents byte-unchanged and verified
Plugin skills renamed session-handoff -> ledgerize and resume-project -> lift-off, published, and continuity-ledger.md updated in lockstep AND committed
Every non-terminal v1 thread carried into v2 as a NEW hand-authored thread preserving work done and work remaining, pointing at the archive, parked at its correct status

v2 plugin installed globally and set up (coexistence verified, core.hooksPath reconciled, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA resolving), with a live /lift-off presenting the seeded roster and a live /ledgerize writing back into the same store

spine.active_goal: Retire the v1 file ledger by freezing it as a grep-only archive and standing v2 up fresh. Archive DONE and verified; 7 v2 threads seeded; Track A confirmed on evidence 2026-07-26. Remaining: prove criterion 5's two open clauses, and get the PreToolUse guard fix published and installed.
spine.next_step: Two items, in order. (1) VERIFY the suspected guard-scope defect: do hooks receive CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, and does the guard actually cover the managed ledger-worktree? (2) Land b0e1079: merge fix/pre-tool-use-guard, publish, re-install, restart. Criterion 5 closes only after both.
open_risks: SUSPECTED DEFECT, verify before anything else: ledger writes land in ~/.claude/plugins/data/session-continuity-continuity-ledger/<project-key>/ledger-worktree/, but a resolveLedgerRoots probe saw only <repo>/.git/ledger, which is EMPTY. If hooks get no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA the guard protects nothing.

Guard fix b0e1079 is committed and pushed on fix/pre-tool-use-guard but NOT merged, published, or installed. The live install is still 0fe1c02, so sessions still run the OLD over-blocking guard: any Bash naming the store plus any '>' anywhere is denied.

Criterion 5 is NOT met. Two of its five clauses are unproven: 'core.hooksPath reconciled' and 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA resolving'. Do not flip it without proving both. The store-root finding above bears directly on the second clause.

The v2 store is git-ref-backed at refs/heads/_ledger, not a working directory. Read thread state with `git show refs/heads/_ledger:threads/<id>.json`. An ls of <repo>/.git/ledger shows an empty dir and looks like data loss - it is not.

Concurrent Claude sessions can run different plugin builds against ONE store. A session started before a re-install keeps the old code in memory (one was 12h stale this session). Build skew is invisible from inside a session; compare process start time against install time.

The new guard under-blocks deliberately in two ways: no environment-variable expansion (rm -rf "$LEDGER/x" escapes) and no symlink resolution. Both fail toward allow, chosen so the read-path fix could not regress into over-blocking.

COMPLETION CRITERIA ARE IMMUTABLE after open_thread - update_thread only toggles done on existing text and rejects the whole call on unknown text. Get criteria right at creation; later work lands in the spine.

Live tool names are mcp__plugin_session-continuity_ledger__*. Never re-use the old mcp__ledger__* ToolSearch check to test whether the server is loaded - it false-negatives even when the server IS running.
Spine list items are capped at 300 chars each; an over-cap item rejects the WHOLE update_thread call rather than truncating.
`chmod -R a-w` is an accident guardrail, not tamper resistance. Never call the freeze immutable. `.git/info/exclude` is clone-local; a fresh clone is protected only by .claude/.gitignore:42.
Three v1 threads were deliberately NOT carried into v2 (decision 0002). Their open items exist ONLY in the frozen archive and nothing will surface them at resume.
